title: Google and Bing verification tags can be set from env, so verifying by tag is possible without DNS access
detail:
metadata.verification in app/layout.tsx reads GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION and BING_SITE_VERIFICATION (blank by default, listed in .env.example with a one-line gate). Optional: OWN-098 and OWN-099 can also use DNS. Context: docs/marketing/off-site-seo-worksheet.md.

Shipped: lib/seo/verification.ts feeds metadata.verification from GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION and BING_SITE_VERIFICATION; both listed blank in .env.example.
